body.prompt: Close-up in the same snowy hanok courtyard: the same young woman in the plum vest kneels and hugs her little son in the red jacket, both looking up with gentle smiles. In the soft-focus background at the top of the persimmon tree, the magpie sits beside the last glowing persimmons in the falling snow, looking down at them and bowing its head. A single tear on the woman's cheek, warm light on their faces. The magpie is exactly the character in the magpie reference image: a small round chibi magpie with a glossy black head, cream-white face and belly, big shiny dark-brown eyes, short black beak, dark navy-blue wings, a red knotted neckerchief and a small brown leather satchel. It does NOT hold a microphone. Style: handcrafted 3D miniature diorama photographed with a macro lens, tilt-shift, shallow depth of field, soft cinematic light, felt, clay, paper and wood textures with tiny hand-painted details, gentle film grain, warm nostalgic color grade, clay figurines with soft rounded faces and deeply emotional Pixar-like expressions, not photorealistic. Vertical 9:16 frame, main subject in the middle of the frame, a calm uncluttered area in the top fifth of the frame. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no hangul, no logos, no labels, no brand names, no watermark anywhere.
